summary:
HighBar first-install qualification is receiver-bound: authenticate repository identity, default branch, permissions, complete current classic/effective/inherited policy and repository/organization runner variables. Preserve the pinned existing ci.yml and all pre-existing leaves while adding exactly the canonical five producer files. Require the candidate original pull_request attempt, ten job/check identities, native app/run/suite joins and successful expected technical steps. Conditional self-hosted skips are acceptable only when the independently observed variable state disables them; reported required checks remain additional. Denied or incomplete metadata cannot prove empty policy. Existing receivers retain their guards. Source integration alone does not establish producer installation, and installation readback remains activation-pending until a genuine ordinary event succeeds.

Observed on 2026-11-02: source PR5262 merged as83871009; HighBar PR18 original ci run41525442352/a1 qualified five hosted successes and five conditional skips. Canonical installation merged as9f9c873a and retained all1,293 original leaves plus five additions. A meaningful PR17 description update, with its reviewed3b2969af head and markers unchanged, produced actual edited pull_request_target run41526415756/a1. Its live-base validator resolved the stale event base b57f11f2 to installed default9f9c873a, and normal maintained inspection returned routineEligibility=passed and producerInstallation=not-selected. Thus an old PR base payload is not evidence of stale validator execution; verify the live-base resolution and exact native job/run instead. Client merge/adoption remains separate. These observations are historical acceptance evidence, not authority for future effects; refresh all operational facts.
title: HighBar bootstrap separates canonical installation from normal client eligibility
